known_gaps.detail: Real mail, Feishu, WeCom, KM/cloud-drive, calendar and proprietary account contents/authorization are not recovered by installing CLIs. Current synthetic service states are independent experimental data, not original remote accounts.
Official CLI --help performs https://qyapi.weixin.qq.com/cli/service/discovery. Offline control fails DNS; online container --help returned exit0. No auth/contact/send was tested.

Actual khal create/list and vdirsyncer discover/update/bidirectional filesystem sync are proven. Real CalDAV HTTP/auth/remote collection is not proven; synthetic local profiles must be configured per attempt.

Root added ECNU single-image editing and generation size normalization in the new bundle only. This does not reproduce ZZZ4 gpt-image-2 multi-image image[]/2048x1152 conditions. See root-owned media controls; no new media/model call by this audit.
edge_tts7.2.8 imports and CLI entry points are available. Online Microsoft TTS synthesis/voice availability are not proven by imports; configured ECNU speech helper is a separate implementation.
Prior ecnu raw API InternalServerError/code500/ENOSPC remains. ShortHTTP200 and a particular artifact control do not establish all long-context requests healthy.

Provided and synthetic files/skill bindings are governed by the unified root inventory. Historical exact bytes/version and unknown original personal resources are not certified by this tools-layer audit.
Native cron runs only while the attempt gateway/container is alive unless a separate persistent service contract is added. Container teardown is not persistent delivery.

Browser file: navigation is unsupported; use local HTTP/Playwright. Native view_image requires supported workspace/media paths. HTTP /tools/invoke read was404 in the earlier control; OS full read/native skill discovery are separate proofs.

Final image contains software/models and local added-wheel/npm artifacts. Legacy apt/npm/PyPI recipe layers still require their base images and public artifacts for a fresh rebuild; an offline apt mirror is not included.

Linux/amd64 Docker and Python3.11+ host are required. Use backend native outside Windows Ubuntu WSL. Old fixed D:/skillloop collectors/Windows venv/absolute freeze paths are not a portable unified launcher.

scope: Tools-layer readiness only; root owns aggregate environment/resources/skills/provider/actor readiness.
